title: Space bound during rewind
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $x$ be an input, and let $r,S$ be natural numbers. Suppose every choice word, when run on $N$ from its initial configuration on $x$, visits at most $S$ work-tape cells in total. For every $i\in\mathbb N$, every $j$ with $0\le j\le r$ such that $j+i=r$, every counter $c$ with $0\le c\le r+1$, and every augmented configuration $C$ in rewind phase at $(j,c)$ with all later blocks blank and their heads at $0$, if every work-tape head of $C$ is within distance $S$ of cell $0$, then after running the amplified machine from $C$ under any choice word, every work-tape head remains within distance $S$ of cell $0$.
